subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should the remaining prevention path land as the scoped completed-turn Anthropic replay policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383, the broader sanitizer approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149, or recovery-only for now?
rationale: The code currently preserves Claude 4-family thinking for replay/cache reasons, and the open fixes choose different compatibility boundaries for provider-owned signed thinking.

options.title: Land scoped replay policy
options.body: Review and, if still clean, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the narrow prevention fix for completed prior turns while keeping active tool-use and Fable behavior intact.

options.title: Choose broader sanitizer
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149 or a variant if maintainers want defense-in-depth across more session-history surfaces despite the wider compatibility blast radius.

options.title: Stay recovery-only
options.body: Keep the merged recovery fixes as the supported mitigation and leave prevention for a later provider-contract design if prompt-cache or replay-compat risk is too high right now.

recommendation.title: Land scoped replay policy
recommendation.body: Review and, if still clean, land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the narrow prevention fix for completed prior turns while keeping active tool-use and Fable behavior intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The current replay-policy source and recent release/provider history point here as the best available owner for the compatibility boundary decision.
